about_the_game:
⚔️ FastMoBa – Dominate the Arena in Just 8 Minutes!

Sick of long matches and unreliable teammates? FastMoBa brings you fast, tactical 5v5 MOBA battles that wrap up in just 8 intense minutes. Jump in, outplay your opponents, and get that competitive fix—perfect for players short on time but big on strategy.

🎮 Quick Matches, Deep Strategy

Battle alongside 4 smart AI allies and crush the enemy team using:

  • 15 unique skins

  • 12 powerful skills

  • 52 items to customize your hero
    With new content added regularly, no two matches play the same.

🌲 Jungle Fights & Power Plays

Take on 8 evolving jungle monsters to gain the upper hand. The longer the match, the tougher the beasts—secure these objectives to tip the tide in your favor.

💀 High Risk, High Reward

Every death has consequences:

  • You only have 3 lives

  • 50% chance to drop an item

  • Lose 25% of your gold on respawn
    Play smart, or pay the price.

❤️ Built by One Dev, Shaped by You

As a passionate solo developer, I want FastMoBa is built with player feedback at its core. Please write review to help shape the future of the ultimate short-session MOBA.

Thank you guy very much!
detailed_description:
RoadMap Development

🔥 What’s Coming Next in the Game? 🔥

Get ready to dive deeper into the ultimate MOBA experience! Here’s what’s on the horizon as I keep leveling up the game:

⚔️ 5v5 Battles Incoming!
Say goodbye to 3v3 — the classic 5v5 mode is here! Optimized for smooth gameplay with more bots and epic team fights. Because every true MOBA needs full teams. (Done!)

🌲 Jungle Role Added!
No MOBA is complete without a jungle. Get ready to control the map and dominate from the shadows. (Done!)

🗺️ Map Overhaul!
I’m redesigning the map with better visuals and performance — ditching the free assets for a pro-level battlefield. (Done!)

🎮 Team Call Function!
Coordinate like a champ! Call out strategies and watch your bots follow your lead. This game-changer takes teamwork to the next level — coming soon!

🏆 Tournament Mode!
Think you’ve got what it takes to be the champion? Compete in thrilling offline tournaments and earn your place at the top, MSI style!

📊 Player Info Board!
Keep track of every player and bot’s level, gear, and stats. Optional, but essential for strategists who want to analyze every move.

⚡ Passive Skills!
Add a new layer of strategy and diversity with unique passive abilities.

🌍 More Maps!
Explore fresh battlegrounds and keep the gameplay exciting and unpredictable.

💰 Heads Up: As I add these epic features, the game price will increase. Grab it now to get in early and grow with the game!

Ready to join the fight? This MOBA is evolving fast — stay tuned for the next big update! 🎮🔥
